name: Full Moon Night
source:
A short story that continues after the events of Paizuri University!

It’s late at night and the moon is full in the night sky. And Kareen is... well... Kareen. Will Bill survive this time?
translation:
一段承接《Paizuri University》剧情的短篇故事！

夜已深，一轮满月高悬夜空。而卡琳…嗯…还是那个卡琳。这次比尔能活下来吗？
